hook: Inter practicals 2027: no jumbling, students write at *their own colleges*
hook_b: Inter practicals 2027: no jumbling, students write at *their own colleges*
tldr: TG BIE had planned to send students to other colleges for practicals (jumbling), but no steps were taken, so the 2027 practicals stay at home colleges.

beats.what: Jumbling is used only for theory exams. Science students have practicals in Physics, Chemistry, Botany and Zoology, 30 marks each.
beats.why: Without jumbling, there are allegations of marks awarded without proper assessment at some private and corporate junior colleges.
beats.care: About 10 lakh students write Inter exams this year; second-year science practicals run Feb 1-10.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TG BIE's 2027 timetable: second-year science practicals Feb 1-10, first-year Feb 11-18, theory from Feb 24 (first year) and Feb 25 (second year).

cards.q: Should Inter practicals be held at a different college, like theory exams?

qs: How can practical marks be checked fairly without jumbling?
Will adding first-year practicals raise costs for families?

facts.t: Around *10 lakh* students are expected to write the Inter public exams this year.

viz.verdict: Key dates for about 10 lakh Inter students
120 marks across four science practicals are assessed by home colleges

learn.t: Jumbling = sending students to write exams at a different college's centre

watch: Whether TG BIE adds any checks on practicals before Feb 1.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: TG BIE drops jumbling for practical exams

fact: Telangana Inter students will again take 2027 practicals at *their own colleges*
twist: Student groups allege some private colleges give the full 30 marks per subject for a fee, and first-year students now have practicals too.
